Id1.text: The University of Cambridge is the alma mater of Brandon Carter, who was born in England. David Sainsbury, also known as the Baron Sainsbury of Turville, and Leszek Borysiewicz are respectively the chancellor and vice chancellor of the University of Cambridge.

Id2.text: Brandon Carter whose birth place was England, graduated from the University of Cambridge with Leszek Borysiewicz as its current Chancellor. David Sainsbury also called as Baron Sainsbury of Turville was once a chancellor of the University of Cambridge.

Id3.text: David Sainsbury (Baron Sainsbury of Turville) and Leszek Borysiewicz hold the positions of Chancellor and Vice Chancellor, respectively, at Englishman Brandon Carter's alma mater, the University of Cambridge.
